# Family curves, torsion subgroup Z/2: record curves

The curves of the family collection with torsion subgroup Z/2, by rank: for each rank the ten smallest
conductors, with generators of the Mordell-Weil group and of the torsion subgroup.
Every curve has proven rank, is given by its global minimal model, and has rank larger than the
generic rank of the family it comes from. Conductors are exact integers; heights are natural
logarithms; the naive height is `log max(abs(c4)^3, c6^2)`.
